protocol.inputs: Only the four original released 211-Angstrom images per window; no in-situ speed, recurrence, EVE, magnetograms or extra solar observations as predictors.
protocol.development: Folds 1-3 fit, Fold4 validation. Fold5 members remain uninterpreted bytes until final freeze. All candidates share exact rows. Fit preprocessing on fitting folds only. Original folds1-4 were used in previous research, so these are development data.
protocol.final: One frozen five-fold pass. For each heldout fold fit on the other four, with all choices/epochs/blends already frozen. No final-test-driven candidate selection. Never output raw holdout labels or images to the agent. Report aggregate scores and fixed ablations only.
protocol.metrics: Mean fold RMSE km/s, Fisher-z averaged fold Pearson r (paper aggregation), arithmetic mean r also disclosed, reduced chi-square using original target sigma, mean fold HSE threat score using original HSEcalc. MAE and 500/600 threshold metrics secondary. Report undefined metrics explicitly. Paper baseline distinct from any modern port.
protocol.success: Predeclared candidate must improve mean fold RMSE and mean fold Pearson r versus released WindNet on identical windows; chi-square and HSE threat score reported, with a stricter all-four-metrics gate separately. Do not claim all-metric improvement unless all four pass. Validation adoption: >=1% RMSE improvement with no Pearson-r decrease; chi2/HSE are guardrails and disclosed tradeoffs.
protocol.stopping: At most six substantive development hypotheses or US$5 estimated incremental Runpod cost. Stop adaptation at freeze, regardless of final outcome. Improvement cannot be guaranteed and failure must be retained.
protocol.prior_exposure: Published historical holdout scores were already in this conversation before this request. This campaign is prospectively sealed against further test feedback, not a pristine blind or fresh confirmatory study.
protocol.publication: User explicitly authorized public RogNet campaign/experiments and commits pushed to GitHub. Dashboard remains owner-private by default.

experiments.label: M1
experiments.observation: Best ridge RMSE74.46,r.551 versus matched LSTM71.66,r.591. Gate failed; incumbent retained.
experiments.hypothesis: Regularized linear temporal heads can beat the matched LSTM.
experiments.method: 18 ridge configurations and three LSTM seeds; identical image windows.
experiments.title: Original image embeddings and regularized temporal heads

experiments.label: M2
experiments.observation: Best raw kernel RMSE75.35,r.538. No mixture passed; baseline retained.
experiments.hypothesis: Nonlinear kernels can improve the frozen embedding forecast.
experiments.method: 45 kernel configurations and five fixed mixtures; common rows.
experiments.title: Nonlinear kernels on the same frozen image embeddings

experiments.label: M3
experiments.observation: Removing sequence loss improved RMSE by 0.55%, below the 1% gate, and reduced HSE threat score. Incumbent retained.
experiments.hypothesis: Removing auxiliary or variance loss terms improves accuracy.
experiments.method: Three loss conditions, each with three identical seeds; matched architecture and rows.
experiments.title: Matched loss ablations for sequence and variance terms

experiments.label: M4
experiments.hypothesis: Spatial dark-area summaries preserve coronal-hole location and complement pooled embeddings.
experiments.method: 48 ridge/tree candidates, fixed mixtures and matched energy-only/spatial-only/combined feature ablations.
experiments.observation: RMSE 70.32 km/s and r 0.613 passed the two-metric validation gate. Chi-square and event threat score worsened; no all-metric improvement claim.
experiments.title: Coronal-hole spatial summaries and feature ablations

experiments.label: M5
experiments.title: Mean-normalized fast-wind weighting
experiments.observation: Weight 4 improved event threat score and chi-square but worsened RMSE and correlation. No balanced adoption.
experiments.method: Two mean-normalized weighting conditions, three seeds each, and fixed mixtures with the spatial candidate.
experiments.hypothesis: Mean-normalized fast-case weights can improve event skill without losing trajectory accuracy.
experiments.success_criteria: Require RMSE gain, nondecreasing correlation, no worse chi-square or HSE threat score.

experiments.label: M6
experiments.title: Amplitude calibration and validation stability audit
experiments.observation: Gain 1.2 on the spatial mixture passed the balanced gate: RMSE 70.23 km/s, r 0.613, chi-square 26.56, event score preserved. Conditional intervals include no improvement.
experiments.method: 280 fixed amplitude calibrations and 2,000 paired whole-block bootstrap draws on validation only.
experiments.hypothesis: Positive amplitude calibration can restore event amplitudes while preserving correlation.
experiments.success_criteria: Require all four metrics to meet the predefined balanced guard.

experiments.label: F1
experiments.title: Frozen image-only comparison on original WindNet folds
experiments.method: 16 frozen model recipes and ablations, all original five folds, identical 2,198 test windows. All fits and checkpoints finish before scores are reported.
experiments.hypothesis: The validation-selected image-only recipe may improve the original paper metrics on the same test windows.
experiments.success_criteria: Fixed primary must improve RMSE and Fisher correlation; strict four-metric improvement is reported separately.
